introduction.value: The poster says Claude Code guided them through booking travel and tours, and created a day-by-day plan website and a printable guide with vouchers, receipts, and flight numbers.

method.value: The poster fed Claude Code several inputs: recordings of calls with locals, transcripts from travel YouTube videos, and their own preferences gathered through back-and-forth questions. outcome.value: They say it worked well end to end and also caught a risk they had missed: labor strikes in the destination country, which led them to revise plans for affected days. No pricing, timing, or booking success metrics were given.

notes.value: The main catch is that the setup depended on collecting outside material first, including call recordings and video transcripts, before Claude Code could synthesize the trip.

source_text.body:
Plan and book a vacation with a travel website and guide
The poster says Claude Code guided them through booking travel and tours, and created a day-by-day plan website and a printable guide with vouchers, receipts, and flight numbers.
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The poster fed Claude Code several inputs: recordings of calls with locals, transcripts from travel YouTube videos, and their own preferences gathered through back-and-forth questions. It used those mixed sources to help plan the itinerary, guide them through booking travel and tours, then generate both a shareable day-by-day travel website and a printable daily packet with vouchers, receipts, and flight details.
How it went
They say it worked well end to end and also caught a risk they had missed: labor strikes in the destination country, which led them to revise plans for affected days. No pricing, timing, or booking success metrics were given.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that the setup depended on collecting outside material first, including call recordings and video transcripts, before Claude Code could synthesize the trip.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Help me plan a trip to [destination] from [start date] to [end date] with a budget of [amount]. Build a simple day-by-day itinerary website and a printable guide that collects flight numbers, hotel and tour confirmations, vouchers, and receipts from the files in [folder path]. Before booking or paying for anything, stop and show me the exact details and price for approval; you're done when I have both the site and a printable PDF.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeCode/comments/1xwlyiw/claude_code_was_incredible_for_vacation_planning
